name: North Industries Group Red Arrow Co., Ltd
summary: North Industries Group Red Arrow Co., Ltd is a manufacturer and global distributor of a wide range of products, with a primary focus on components for internal combustion engines. Its diverse portfolio also encompasses military and security items like caliber shells, rockets, missiles, and various submunitions. Furthermore, the company produces industrial materials such as superhard and non-metallic substances, as well as aircraft components and equipment designed for counter-terrorism and riot control. These offerings find applications in sectors including specialized vehicles and automotive parts. Headquartered in Nanyang, China, the firm previously operated as Hunan Jiangnan Red Arrow Co., Ltd until its renaming in January 2017.
